allow:
Bash(gh pr create --title "Add GitHub Action to delete stale merged branches" --body "$\(cat <<''EOF''
## Summary
- Adds a new `workflow_dispatch` GitHub Action that deletes branches older than 6 months that have been fully merged into the default branch
- Skips protected branches and a safelist \(`master`, `staging`, `production`\)
- Fixes existing `draft_inactive_prs.rb` script to paginate through all open PRs instead of only the first page \(default 30\)

## Test plan
- [ ] Trigger the `Delete Stale Merged Branches` workflow manually from the Actions tab
- [ ] Verify it only deletes merged branches older than 6 months
- [ ] Verify protected branches are not deleted

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]\(https://claude.com/claude-code\)
EOF
\)")
